split_method: Original official splits; exact and near duplicates removed globally, keeping the earliest split. No speaker metadata used. Speakers can overlap between splits; this is not a source-held-out benchmark.
limitations: Short US political statements from 2007–2016, not general news articles.
Text patterns alone cannot verify factual truth.
Middle truthfulness labels are excluded; this is not the original six-class LIAR task.
Uncalibrated probabilities may be overconfident and should not be interpreted as truth probabilities.
Speakers, topics, and political framing may overlap across official splits. Near-duplicate filtering reduces, but cannot eliminate, leakage.
Language and sentiment heuristics do not establish misinformation.
license_note: Original LIAR distribution contains no explicit blanket license grant. Underlying PolitiFact content may have separate terms. Data is downloaded locally and not redistributed; review rights for your intended use.
